_meta.note: Frontend locale pack; keys map to data-i18n attributes in index.html

keyframe.title: Keyframe Driven
keyframe.desc: Generate an end frame per shot first, then feed [start, end] into H3 so the model interpolates between two anchored compositions — far better control than reference-image-only mode.

canvas.title: Storyboard Canvas
canvas.desc: Drag cards to reorder shots; re-run a single storyboard or video directly on the card.

consistency.title: Consistency Board
consistency.desc: Cross-shot comparison of the same character's look and costume (perceptual hash + multimodal semantics).

analytics.title: Cost & Time Board
analytics.desc: Per-project stage duration, call counts and estimated electricity cost.

export.title: Export Center
export.desc: One-click export to CapCut draft / Premiere FCPXML / SRT subtitles / frame sequence list.

engine.title: Engines & Plugins
engine.desc: Inspect available engines per stage and registered pipeline plugins.

tasks.title: Tasks & Resume
tasks.desc: Task lifecycle persisted to disk; interrupted/failed tasks can be previewed and resumed, skipping units already present on disk.

auto.title: Unattended Auto Production
auto.sub: Upload a novel to create a project → settle style with the director AI → start hosting. The machine then produces every episode chapter by chapter (script · assets · storyboards · video · voice · final cut), auto-retrying anything that fails QC. You only review the final cuts below.
auto.s1d: Supports txt / docx / pdf / epub / html; chapters are split automatically.
auto.s2d: Settle genre / art style / pacing / shot count via chat, applied to production config in one click.
auto.s3d: Runs 24/7 chapter by chapter and resumes automatically after a restart.
auto.curveTip: Bar height = episodes finished that hour; red = failed
auto.deliverEmpty: No final cuts awaiting review. Each finished episode will show up here once hosting runs.
auto.foot: Hosting is single-threaded and serial (one episode at a time) to avoid VRAM contention. Pause takes effect at step boundaries, so no half-finished artifacts are produced.

state.pausedSub: Hosting is paused and will not start new production
state.idleSub: {n} project(s) enabled; every episode is finished or waiting for a human
state.idleSubNone: No project enabled yet — upload a novel above and start auto production
state.offHasPlan: Enabled projects exist; flip the switch or press Resume to continue
state.offSub: Follow the three steps above: upload → direct the style with AI → start auto production

auto.curveEmpty: No production records yet. Once hosting finishes its first episode, an hourly output curve appears here.
auto.epEmpty: Nothing to produce yet. Upload a novel to create a project; episodes are split from chapters automatically.
auto.planEmpty: No projects yet. Import a novel under Upload to create one automatically.
auto.epOthers: {n} more episodes queued in other projects
